headline: Putin says Ukraine hits Russian oil plants despite Trump’s requests
summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin said Ukraine has continued attacks on Russian oil refineries despite requests from US President Donald Trump to stop, pledging retaliation. Kyiv says it will halt strikes on energy targets only if Moscow does the same.
why: Strikes on refineries can reduce Russian refining output and fuel supply, affecting global product markets and crude demand.
why_moved: Ongoing Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries, and Moscow's pledge to retaliate, raise the risk of further disruption to energy supply.
